title: Route observability, locality, topology, telemetry, seam tracing, and calibration

sources.notes: Authoritative offline SBRTv1 reader/writer and temporal-locality semantics. The model retains bounded validated/sorted top-2 records, exact consecutive-run, width-two working-set, capacity-two LRU, and scaled Jaccard behavior; NumPy I/O, arbitrary geometry/windows/capacities, report formatting, and the 100000-token null simulation are abstracted.

Owns record selection, contiguous/replicated/single-card route counting, integer measured-knot lookup, exhaustive contiguous boundary rows, synthetic inputs, and CLI interpretation limits. The four-expert model evaluates both legal boundaries and all three topology families from each parameterized record; production-size distributions, percentiles, and combinatorial uniform expectation are abstracted.

Live global-ID histogram and SBRTv1 producer. The model preserves opt-in lazy lifecycle, per-record accounting, pending/durable separation, flush-without-close, close, histogram reset/calibration, and dimension/identity failure observations. Device tensors, eight pinned slots, CUDA events, 65536-record file blocks, CSV bytes, and atexit mechanics are explicit atomic abstractions.

Opt-in sampled decode seam lifecycle. The model distinguishes accepted decode-shaped samples, current-stream-capture skips, large-M skips, and one-time nonempty dump. Timestamp values, CUDA event elapsed-time numerics, NPZ serialization, cadence counters, fallback layer rollover, and NaN details are documented but abstracted.

Worker collective-RPC snapshot/reset surface. The model preserves mutable-counter reset, monotonic provider generation/dispatch baseline, unavailable scoped delta after generation change/regression, histogram liveness, and dump lifecycle. Full route/poller/memory/power dictionaries and external device reads are inventory observations rather than tensor/device simulation.

All-CUDA frequency-calibration workflow contract: configure histogram, load/filter corpus, warm up, reset, execute, worker-RPC dump, shutdown, and offline CSV analysis. The model preserves Warmup->Reset->Measuring->Dumped and warmup exclusion. The checked-in benchmark import path does not match the present repository layout, reported in the chapter rather than corrected.

Shell launcher has no source-language symbols. It sources oneAPI, enables strict shell mode, prepends the venv, and invokes calibration. Its cd plus Python relative path resolves to src/src/phase7 in this checkout; the chapter records that source contradiction.

CPU harness contract for repeated-versus-uniform Jaccard separation, chance working sets, LRU hit rates/accounting, and report sections. It is not itself modeled as runtime behavior and was not run by this agent.

CPU harness contract for uniform analytic maximum, clustered topology separation, single-row filtering, tail-run selection, and exhaustive boundary count. It is not itself modeled as runtime behavior and was not run by this agent.

Relevant call-site boundary: lazily creates observers from qualified geometry, observes global IDs above all-CUDA/placement remapping, executes detailed trace copy through an eager break, and places seam marks around local/take/add work. Hybrid compute itself belongs to another model.
Relevant call-site boundary wrapping Worker.execute_model with seam step begin/end timing and profiler trigger. Plugin registration and other patches belong to integration/admission models.

assumptions: The bounded model receives records after read_trace validation and in (step,row) order; monotonic coordinates make duplicate keys unreachable inside the model.

The model fixes one layer, top_k=2, expert IDs 0..3, at most four records, LRU capacity two, CUDA prefix [0,1), and configured contiguous boundary 2; these are finite exploration bounds, not production geometry.
Jaccard is stored in sixths because every top-2 set pair has score 0, 1/3, or 1; general floating-point reduction is outside the model.
Kernel knots are copied from KERNEL_US as tenths of microseconds for route counts 0..2. They are source accounting inputs, not a new performance claim or prediction.
Histogram and detailed trace observe global expert IDs before compact placement remapping, as enforced by the routed_experts call sites.
Version-1 traces do not identify request or prefill/decode phase. Single-row selection is only a concurrency-1 decode proxy and requires the documented capture procedure.
LRU order processes expert IDs in stored record order and continues across step gaps, while Jaccard and working-set windows reset at row/step discontinuities.
Telemetry reads occur through collective_rpc between engine steps; absent keys retain the source meaning inactive rather than enabled-and-zero.
A provider health delta is meaningful only within one generation and with a nondecreasing monotonic dispatch count.
Seam timestamp/event numerics and file serialization are external observations; the model preserves enable/sample/skip/dump ordering only.
The calibration Python and shell path mismatches are preserved as checked-in contradictions; no external symlink or module installation is assumed.

implementation_checks.description: Construct top-2 records at steps 0,1,3,4 for one row and compare Python run boundaries [(0,1),(3,4)] with Reyu continuesRun decisions.

Feed ordered experts [0,1],[0,2],[2,3],[2,3] at capacity two; compare Python hits=4 and requests=8 directly with lruCapacityTwoHits([0,1,0,2,2,3,2,3]), then compare per-access hit/MRU/LRU states with lruCapacityTwoHit/NextRecent/NextOlder.
Write/read the four-record SBRTv1 fixture and compare two Jaccard comparisons (sum 4/3), two width-two working sets (distinct sum 5), and capacity-two LRU totals with witnessExactLocality.
CPU-generate bad magic/version/record-size, duplicate expert, duplicate coordinate, out-of-range ID, and truncated payload cases; confirm rejection corresponds to rejectMalformedTrace.

Use the four-record fixture with CUDA prefix 1 and split boundary 2; compare contiguous critical total 6/cost 126.0 us, replicated total 4/cost 123.2 us, and single-card accumulators with the model actions.
Sweep the four-expert fixture with CUDA prefix 1 and confirm boundary 3 has the lower accumulated max count than boundary 2 and is selected by witnessBoundaryThree.
CPU-call with baseline (generation=1,dispatches=10): verify (1,14) yields delta 4, generation 2 is unavailable, and same-generation raw dispatches below 10 are unavailable.
With CPU top-k tensors, observe one record, flush, observe another, close, and read both; compare the allowed flushThenResume transition and final durability.

Source-inspect path resolution after cd: confirm the launcher targets src/src/phase7/calibrate_routes.py and the Python sys.path insertion targets src/benchmarks in this checkout; record as a contradiction rather than executing the hardware workflow.
